name: AI assistant
description: Suggests replies right above the message box, writes the message you describe, rewrites your drafts, and catches you up on unread chats, with a private model on this computer or the AI service you choose. Nothing is sent without your click.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Who answers: Claude (anthropic), OpenAI (openai), your own OpenAI-compatible server (compatible), or the private model on this computer (built-in).

endpoint.title: Server address
endpoint.description: For a compatible server only: its https:// address, such as https://llm.example.org/v1, or a server on this computer, such as http://localhost:11434/v1.

context.title: Messages to send
context.description: How many of the chat's latest messages the assistant sends, at most. YapYap's own limit in Settings → Extensions still applies.

localOnly.title: Local-only mode
localOnly.description: Only ask an AI server running on this computer, so nothing about your chats leaves it.
